description: The bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods," illustrates the average entropy values for three different sycophancy reduction techniques—Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue)—across three AI models: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The vertical axis represents the "Entropy Average Values," scaled from 3.5 to 6.0, while the horizontal axis lists the "Different AI Models." For each model, three bars are grouped together, with the legend indicating the corresponding method. In GPT-4, the Source Info method has the highest entropy (approximately 5.5), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.4), and then Baseline (approximately 5.0). For Claude, the Source Info method again shows the highest entropy (approximately 5.7), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.6), and then Baseline (approximately 5.1). In Llama, the Source Info method has the highest entropy (approximately 5.8), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.8), and then Baseline (approximately 5.4). Overall, the Source Info method consistently yields the highest entropy values across all three models, while the Baseline method consistently yields the lowest.
